decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA shows $99,918 and the base plus commission stub annualizes to $100,500, supporting the stated income with a commission history.
A $10,610 e-transfer on 2026-09-04 is explained by a vehicle bill of sale dated September 14, a date mismatch, and leaves thin margin for closing costs without it.
Valeur Reference Inc. (on panel) valued the property at $734,000 against a $695,000 price in a report dated 2026-08-25.
The 2026-09-02 letter on letterhead, signed by HR, confirms permanent full-time employment since 2021 with salary consistent with the application.
GDS is about 31.7% and TDS about 38.4% using the declared and bureau-matched liabilities, under the limits, with a 735 credit score.
